$comment: Intake requirements per APEX website ticket class. Used by tests/validate-ticket.mjs. Field paths refer to the APEX task JSON: originalSubmission.*, customFields.*, url, description. 0.3 added the non-website classes routed by the field map and refined Community tickets by failing surface. 0.4: every class carries doneWhen, the observer checks that file it, and its Missing Info routing label, so there is one taxonomy (observer check -> ticket class -> routing label). 0.9: the staff classes (add, update, photo, bulk) carry the framing evidence (tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing plus the section capture of the card) in doneWhen and evidence, decision 2026-09-22. 0.10: the copy and launch-copy classes (copy, launch-copy-request, observer-launch-copy, observer-brand-leak) name tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual in doneWhen as INFO-only (findings are recorded in the note, not blocking) and the observer-brand-visual class receives agent-found visual brand findings, decision 2026-09-22. 0.11 (2026-09-24, QC loop redesign workstream 3): every class's observerChecks list is also its intake match rule for customFields.check (the observer's own check name, glob * allowed; one class per check, tests/build-policy.mjs refuses an overlap); match.urlPattern gates every rule of a class on the ticket URL; observer-page-transient receives rendered-page timeouts, 5xx pages and all-images-failed findings on a page URL, observer-health keeps loop health on the workflow or sheet URL only, and the application-route (Finalsite redirect) findings are observer-link-cta, not observer-event. 0.13 (2026-09-25): lifecycle-media findings, including the legacy page-check id open-intro-media-approved, route to observer-media-identity so the East Bay ticket cannot fall into needs-rule or be duplicated by the observer filer. 0.14 (2026-09-25, QC loop repair plan repair 7, one id everywhere): every class may carry matchRequirementIds (check bundle row ids, spec/check-rows.json) and matchCheckIds (tests/page-check.mjs and agent-found check ids); agent/intake-policy.mjs classifyTicket and agent/file-found-ticket.mjs match customFields.requirementId and customFields.checkId against them before the observer check name and before any title pattern, and tests/build-policy.mjs refuses an id claimed by two classes. campus-page-stale-launch-media moves from observer-launch-copy to observer-media-identity, the class of its row campus.intro.media.current; the coverage checks (check bundle 1.3) are claimed by the classes of their rows. 0.15 (2026-09-25, repair 3): observer-health claims bundle-conformance, comparator-unsupported and the vision-pass checks and their check bundle 1.4 rows (site.loop.health.conformance, site.loop.health.comparator-unsupported, site.loop.health.vision-pass, site.loop.health.vision-pass-budget, site.loop.health.vision-pass-errors). 0.16 (2026-10-05): observer-link-cta claims campus.enrollment-state.controls and its page-check id open-enrollment-state-controls (bundle 1.11, the waitlist apply controls; MacKenzie Price 2026-10-05). 0.17 (2026-10-09): the APEX website request form stores requests in typed web* fields. changeDetail reads them (form:website-detail) and destinationUrl reads the link destination or the attached file (form:link-destination); form request types copy-faq, link-resource, link-resource/info-packet and update-info map to copy, link-cta, packet and program-info, and decide the class ahead of title patterns. Observer classes never match a form ticket (Denver FAQ, Denver packet and Bethesda/Chantilly copy tickets bounced or were misrouted). 0.18 (2026-10-09): the form type event_listing ("Event missing or incorrect on the website") maps to event-request and its fields (event name or registration URL, issue, notes) are the requested change; a form type with no entry yet is read from all of its filled web* fields instead of bounced (Denver event listing cmv16zwye bounced for "the exact change").

other-workflow.note: Not a website page edit; route to the workflow that owns it (packets, new program launch, videography, PR, brand).
other-workflow.doneWhen: the owning workflow reports completion and the observer rerun clears the check

packet.note: A request about the info packet document (wrong facts, wrong year, missing campus) is packet work in Canva and Flipsnack, not a page edit. The website part is only the link swap once an approved packet exists (link-cta).
packet.doneWhen: an approved packet with the requested facts is published, the campus page button points at it and returns 200 logged out, and the requester confirms

match.detailPattern: make (?:this |the )?event public|add (?:this |the |these |our |us and )?(?:events?|info sessions?|virtual info)|events? (?:page|need to be added|to the .{0,30}website)|drop ?down menu on this page|info sessions? (?:as|show|time|listed)|open house events?

event-request.note: Events reach the site from HubSpot Marketing Events through the WordPress plugin. A request about events on a campus page is triaged by the website operators: campus missing from the events drop-down, wrong time zone display, or a campus strip not showing events is plugin configuration (events-plugin-owner, Garbhit Sharma); an event missing because it is not public or has the wrong program interest is the HubSpot owner, asked per event, never by reassigning the ticket. Hailey McSpadden, 2026-09-17: event tickets are not hers by default.
event-request.doneWhen: the requested events show on the campus strip and /upcoming-events/ after the next 30-minute sync, verified by the website agent

map-community-request.note: Map pins, Join the Community buttons, and community destinations come from HubSpot Programs through the growth map API and the map app; not a page edit. Route to the growth-map owner or expansion new programs.
map-community-request.doneWhen: the pin or button renders on map.app.alpha.school and the observer map checks pass

platform-request.note: Site-wide or infrastructure work: DNS, domains, meta tags, templates, gallery widgets. Route to the Elementor owner or WordPress admin; never a campus content edit.
platform-request.doneWhen: the change is verified on two pages and the observer site checks pass

match.detailPattern: launching fall|launching in fall|says? (?:coming soon|now open|launching)|still says|now open in the description

launch-copy-request.note: Same pathway as observer-launch-copy: the sentence is n8n-written from website_campus_intro; the card is WordPress-direct. Run step 1b; the sentence part becomes hubspot-data.
launch-copy-request.doneWhen: the page shows the open sentence after the next 00:15 CT n8n run and the approved card; tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual is run on the page and its findings (font, contrast, off-palette fields and headlines, logo file) are recorded in the ticket note as INFO, not blocking, until spec/brand-visual.json check.enforcement.mode is enforced

sync-mapping.note: The source value is right but the way n8n derives the page element is wrong or missing. Fix is a change to the n8n workflow (or the field map). Owner is the n8n-sync-owner; the decision is recorded in docs/decisions.md.
sync-mapping.verify: page after the next n8n run on two campuses
sync-mapping.doneWhen: two campuses render correctly after a run with the new derivation, and spec/campus-page-field-map.json is updated

sync-delivery.note: Source and mapping are right but the page still shows the old value after the scheduled run: the run failed or skipped the page. Owner: n8n-sync-owner.
sync-delivery.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value after the next 00:15 CT n8n run, and the observer rerun clears the check

hubspot-data.note: A HubSpot Program (or Marketing Event) field holds a value that contradicts the requirement for the campus state. Fix is in HubSpot through the APEX campus Program editor; the website follows after the 00:15 CT n8n run. Never a WordPress edit.
hubspot-data.verify: page after the next n8n run
hubspot-data.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value after the next 00:15 CT n8n run, and the observer rerun clears the check

sheet-data.note: The onboarding sheet Website Copy tab holds wrong copy. Fix is in the sheet; owner to be named (open gap).
sheet-data.verify: page after the next n8n run
sheet-data.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value after the next 00:15 CT n8n run, and the observer rerun clears the check

staff-photo.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing passes on desktop and mobile for the card (the bound headshot is inside its rendered frame: full head, no top or bottom cut) and the section capture of the card is attached with agent/attach-evidence.mjs --section, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

staff-add.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing passes on desktop and mobile for the card (the bound headshot is inside its rendered frame: full head, no top or bottom cut) and the section capture of the card is attached with agent/attach-evidence.mjs --section, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

match.titlePattern: Update a team member|card has no photo|card without (?:a )?photo

staff-update.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing passes on desktop and mobile for the card (the bound headshot is inside its rendered frame: full head, no top or bottom cut) and the section capture of the card is attached with agent/attach-evidence.mjs --section, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

staff-remove.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

match.detailPattern: team section|guides\x27? profiles|update (?:all )?(?:staff|our staff|our team|the team)|team bio|bios and pictures|add (?:these|the following) (?:people|team members)|new guides|staff updated

staff-bulk.note: A roster update for several people at once, usually with a deck or sheet. Executed as one staff-card recipe per person; each person needs name, title, bio, and headshot. Missing Info lists the people whose inputs are absent.
staff-bulk.doneWhen: every named card renders with the requested name, title, bio, and photo; ring 2 passes; tests/page-check.mjs team-photo-framing passes on desktop and mobile for the card (the bound headshot is inside its rendered frame: full head, no top or bottom cut) and the section capture of the card is attached with agent/attach-evidence.mjs --section for every card touched; requester confirms

copy.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply; tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual is run on the page and its findings (font, contrast, off-palette fields and headlines, logo file) are recorded in the ticket note as INFO, not blocking, until spec/brand-visual.json check.enforcement.mode is enforced

match.detailPattern: application (?:page|link|route)|apply(?:ing)? (?:link|page|button|route)|book a (?:call|tour)|calendar link|info session link|community link|packet link

link-cta.note: A CTA or link request from the form: Apply, Book a Call, Book a Tour, calendar, packet, community. The destination usually comes from HubSpot (admission_link, call_scheduling_link) or a source owner; run step 1b before editing. Application routes (submission_campus) are hubspot-program-admin territory.
link-cta.doneWhen: the CTA resolves logged out to the right campus and year, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check

program-info.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

observer-launch-copy.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply; tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual is run on the page and its findings (font, contrast, off-palette fields and headlines, logo file) are recorded in the ticket note as INFO, not blocking, until spec/brand-visual.json check.enforcement.mode is enforced

match.titlePattern: HubSpot says|Operations says|source address|source name|source coordinates|HubSpot email|Search and QC cannot read

observer-fact-sync.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

observer-brand-leak.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply; tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual is run on the page and its findings (font, contrast, off-palette fields and headlines, logo file) are recorded in the ticket note as INFO, not blocking, until spec/brand-visual.json check.enforcement.mode is enforced

match.titlePattern: off-brand font|not Montserrat|brand-visual|off-palette|sky blue on white|logo file

observer-brand-visual.note: Agent-found visual brand findings from tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual (spec/brand-visual.json): a text element not in Montserrat, a never-row contrast pair, an off-palette large field or headline colour, or a logo image that is not a canonical file from playbook/brand/assets. The observed and expected lines carry the selector, the value, and the rule. A finding inside a shared template (header, footer, the campus template section) is one ticket for the template, not one per page; a plugin-styled element (Alpha HubSpot Events cards) goes to the plugin owner. Word-level copy findings are never this class (they are copy / observer-brand-leak).
observer-brand-visual.doneWhen: the public page renders the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear (Montserrat on the element, a palette pair from the contrast table, a canonical logo file), ring 2 passes, and tests/page-check.mjs brand-visual no longer lists the finding; a change to kit 8 typography or colours, or to the header or footer logo, is a decision for website operations first (docs/decisions.md 2026-09-22) and is never made under a campus ticket

observer-media-identity.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

match.titlePattern: missing an APPLY TODAY|admission_link|calendar|Book a Call|Apply stays on the HubSpot form|submission_campus

observer-link-cta.doneWhen: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check; if the element is automation-written per spec/campus-page-field-map.json, the ticket is re-classed and this default does not apply

match.titlePattern: info packet is not publicly accessible|packet link returns|missing an info-packet CTA

observer-packet.doneWhen: the owning workflow reports completion and the observer rerun clears the check

match.titlePattern: public in HubSpot, but missing|event feed shows other-campus|registration link returns

observer-event.doneWhen: the event state is right on /upcoming-events/ and the campus strip after the next 30-minute sync, and the observer rerun clears the check

match.titlePattern: header overlaps|overflows horizontally|outside the mobile viewport|clipped text|cut heads?|cut off on (?:desktop|mobile)|carousel has no arrows|no (?:previous\/next|prev\/next) arrows

observer-layout.doneWhen: the owning workflow reports completion and the observer rerun clears the check

match.titlePattern: expected rendered HTTP 2xx page, found|expected HTTP 2xx, found (?:5\d\d|timeout)|visible image failed to render|images? failed to render

observer-page-transient.note: A rendered-page timeout (page.goto 20 s), a 5xx on a page, or a page where visible images failed to render in one observer run, on a page URL. Transient until it reproduces: the website agent re-renders the page on desktop and mobile (tests/rendered-controls.mjs), closes on verification with the pair attached when it does not reproduce, and routes to website-operations with the timings when it does (F partition, 2026-09-24; docs/observer-requirements.md asks the observer for a second attempt before filing). Never loop health (observer-health is the workflow or sheet URL only) and never a template defect (observer-layout).
observer-page-transient.doneWhen: the page renders HTTP 2xx with its images on desktop and mobile in two agent renders (rendered-controls.mjs, pair attached), or the timeout reproduces and website-operations holds the ticket with the timings; the observer rerun clears the check

match.titlePattern: National Growth Map|community\.alpha\.school|Operations says .* Map says|Community (?:slug|program|visibility|routing)

observer-map-community.doneWhen: the owning workflow reports completion and the observer rerun clears the check
observer-map-community.note: Classify the failing surface before execution. WordPress CTA placement uses link-cta; a map destination routes to growth-map-owner; a Community record, slug, visibility, or router routes to community-app-owner. Do not change another surface under this ticket.

match.titlePattern: source collection|snapshot no older|expected rendered HTTP 2xx|expected HTTP 2xx|failed to render

observer-health.doneWhen: the owning workflow reports completion and the observer rerun clears the check
observer-health.note: Loop health: a failed or degraded source collection, a stale sheet snapshot, a browser error budget, or a timeout or render failure the observer could only attribute to its own run (the ticket URL is the workflow or the sheet, not a page). The observer owner fixes the loop; no website change. The same finding with a page URL is observer-page-transient, never this class.

page-status.note: Publishing and unpublishing require page-family, redirect, sitemap, noindex, Markdown and LLM-export decisions. The scheduled Alpha MCP path is not documented as integrated for status.
page-status.doneWhen: the approved public or non-public route, redirect, sitemap, robots, Markdown and LLM-export behavior are verified

seo-redirect.note: Identify whether WordPress, Yoast, n8n, a template, Redirection, infrastructure or generated output owns the exact field before editing.
seo-redirect.doneWhen: canonical, metadata, indexability, sitemap, redirect, schema, Markdown and LLM surfaces match the approved page-family rule

form-admissions.note: Forms and application paths can create contacts, messages, tasks or charges. They require an inventory row and approved safe QA.
form-admissions.doneWhen: the approved end-to-end campus route, confirmation and downstream behavior are verified without unintended communication or charge

match.titlePattern: global header|global footer|navigation|site menu|popup|global script|consent banner
match.detailPattern: global header|global footer|navigation|site menu|popup|global script|consent banner

global-template.note: Global template and script work is staged human project work with complete dependency and rollback evidence.
global-template.doneWhen: the target and representative pages pass shared-surface, accessibility, form, consent, desktop and mobile verification

page-presentation.note: Page-local presentation of existing content, such as centering the waitlist notice. Route directly to website operations for bounded execution; no new wording or brand approval is required for alignment alone. This class does not promote an unsupported tool operation.
page-presentation.doneWhen: Requested presentation is verified on the canonical public page at desktop and mobile sizes; text, destinations, embedded behavior and unrelated components remain unchanged; snapshot and exact diff are attached.

from: title:(?:Add|Update) (?:a )?team member(?: to| on)?(?: program page)? — ([^—]+?) —

staffEmail.missingText: the team member's Alpha email address used to identify the exact person

staffHeadshot.missingText: the headshot attached to this request as an APEX asset (Drive, Slack, or deck links are not accepted: the agent cannot verify who a file belongs to)

changeDetail.missingText: the exact change requested (current value and new value)

observerId.missingText: the observer id (or, on an agent-found ticket, its idempotency key)

sourceValue.missingText: the source-of-truth value and a ruling that the source is current

approvedMedia.missingText: an approved open-campus card or video for this campus (registry/campus-open-media.json), owner Yash Chitneni

destinationUrl.missingText: the destination URL the CTA should point to, confirmed reachable

bulkAssets.missingText: headshots and bios attached to this request as APEX assets, one Add a team member request per person
